articles.title: From a 6'7" Bearskin Giant to a Gap-Toothed Prince: Inside the Pomp and Poignancy of Trooping the Colour
articles.summary: King Charles III celebrated his official birthday with a massive military parade, but the day was tinged with loss. A soldier who died in a riding accident was honored, while Prince Louis charmed the crowd.

articles.title: 'Gambling with Young People's Lives': Molly Russell's Father Slams PM's Rush to Ban Social Media for Under-16s
articles.summary: Ian Russell, whose daughter Molly took her own life after viewing harmful content online, says a proposed ban on under-16s using social media is 'deplorable.' He accuses the prime minister of breaking promises and ignoring real solutions.

articles.title: Under Cover of Tarps and Thunderstorms: Trump's Name Removed from Kennedy Center After Court Order
articles.summary: Workers removed President Trump's name from the Kennedy Center facade in a pre-dawn operation, hours after a court-ordered deadline. The administration argued the name was crucial for fundraising, but a judge said only Congress can rename the building.
